build_bert_embedding_model: build a BERT embedding model using vLLM with configurable pooling and encoder
create_bert_pooling_model: create a BERT pooling model that produces sequence-level embeddings from hidden states
run_bert_sequence_classification: run BERT-based sequence classification with configurable number of labels
run_bert_token_classification: run BERT-based token classification for per-token labeling tasks
run_splade_sparse_embedding: run SPLADE sparse embedding pooling with max or sum aggregation over token logits
